migrate-v18.description: Applies automated @clr/angular v17→v18 source migrations (templates, imports, CSS). Run with: ng generate @clr/angular:migrate-v18

migrate-v19.description: Applies automated @clr/angular v18→v19 source migrations (cds-icon → clr-icon, ClrIconModule → ClrIcon). Run with: ng generate @clr/angular:migrate-v19
